global_rules.no_event_meaning: NO OBSERVATION EXISTS; DO NOT MATERIALIZE A NULL PLACEHOLDER ROW

subjects.description: One synthetic adult cardiac subject; no real identifiers.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: Deterministic opaque linkage identifier; contains no target, subtype, or split information.

fields.name: age_years
fields.description: Synthetic adult age; distribution is benchmark design, not epidemiology.

fields.name: sex_category
fields.description: Synthetic sex/gender representation under a reviewed controlled vocabulary.

fields.name: cardiac_condition_group
fields.description: Broad synthetic cardiac phenotype; composition is a design mixture, never prevalence.

episodes.description: One canonical ICU-like episode per core-project subject.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: Subject linkage only.

fields.name: stay_id
fields.description: Deterministic opaque episode identifier; contains no outcome or split information.

fields.name: intime
fields.description: Generated structural episode start used by downstream clock and padding logic.

fields.name: outtime
fields.description: Generated structural episode end used only for legality, eligibility, censoring, and labels.

fields.name: episode_sequence
fields.description: Core v1 generates exactly one retained episode per subject.

fields.name: generator_subject_stream_id
fields.description: RNG substream identity for regeneration; never a feature.

raw_events.description: Long-form observed physiological events; absent measurements have no row.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Deterministic event identity and stable tie-breaker.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: Subject linkage only.

fields.name: stay_id
fields.description: Episode linkage only.

fields.name: event_time
fields.description: Availability time used for cutoff truncation; never a future-derived feature.

fields.name: interval_start
fields.description: Start of collection interval, required for interval measurements such as urine output.

fields.name: interval_end
fields.description: End/availability time of an interval measurement.

fields.name: concept_code
fields.description: Versioned physiological concept; eligibility still requires event_time <= cutoff.

fields.name: value_numeric
fields.description: Observed numeric value; exactly one of numeric/text value is present.

fields.name: value_text
fields.description: Observed categorical value; exactly one of numeric/text value is present.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Canonical generator unit; categorical events use the literal unit 'category'.

fields.name: generator_component
fields.description: Process identity used for audit and regeneration.

support_intervals.description: Closed-open support intervals that can be adapted to Pulkit state contracts.

fields.name: support_event_id
fields.description: Deterministic support interval identity.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: Subject linkage only.

fields.name: stay_id
fields.description: Episode linkage only.

fields.name: support_type
fields.description: Top-level support process; visible only through cutoff-safe state derivation.

fields.name: support_category
fields.description: Qualifying/nonqualifying category mapped by the future synthetic event dictionary.

fields.name: agent_key
fields.description: Synthetic vasopressor vocabulary key; final names require review.

fields.name: respiratory_category
fields.description: Required for respiratory intervals; only INVASIVE qualifies for the endpoint.

fields.name: interval_start
fields.description: Genuine state transition time; visible at cutoffs on/after start.

fields.name: interval_end
fields.description: Closed-open cessation boundary; future end must be hidden until it occurs.

fields.name: rate_value
fields.description: Optional vasopressor rate for interval segment.

fields.name: rate_unit
fields.description: Required when rate_value is present; final vocabulary requires review.

fields.name: normalization_provenance_ref
fields.description: Binds interval to its synthetic mapping/adapter semantics.

generator_internal_audit.description: Optional development-only validation structure; prohibited from final raw artifacts.

fields.name: internal_state_id
fields.description: Internal trace identity.

fields.name: stay_id
fields.description: Internal episode linkage.

fields.name: simulation_time
fields.description: Internal simulation step.

fields.name: latent_state_vector
fields.description: Never exported, preprocessed, modeled, served, or included in final dataset.
